description: A boat that finished and was then disqualified, and one that retired after finishing, vacate their places: every boat behind each moves up one place.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A6.1: 'If a boat is disqualified from a race, or retires after finishing, or is scored Did not sail the course, each boat with a worse finishing place shall be moved up one place.' A5.2 scores DSQ and RET one more than the boats entered; A4 scores the remaining finishers by their places after the move-up.
working: 6 boats entered, so DSQ and RET score 7.
R1 crossing order A B C D E F. A (1st across) is DSQ and D (4th across) retired after finishing, so both places are vacated and the boats behind move up: B 1, C 2, E 3, F 4. A DSQ 7, D RET 7.
Without A6.1, B, C, E and F would have scored 2, 3, 5 and 6 in R1.
No two nets are equal: C, B, E, F, A, D.
